The price of an item is first increased by 10% and then decreased by 15%. What is the net percentage change in its price?
questions.explanation: Net factor = (1 + 10/100)(1 - 15/100) = 187/200, so the change is -13/2%: a 13/2% decrease.

What are the roots of x² + 3x - 28 = 0?
questions.explanation: Sum of roots = -3, product = -28: the roots are -7 and 4.

questions.text: A can do a job in 40 days and B in 20 days. They work together for 2 days, then B leaves. In how many more days will A finish the job?
questions.explanation: In 2 days they do 3/20 of the work; 17/20 is left, which A does in 17/20 × 40 = 34 days.

questions.title: Minimum platforms
questions.text:
Trains arrive and depart at a station (times in minutes from midnight). A platform is busy from a train's arrival to its departure, inclusive. Print the minimum number of platforms needed so no train waits.

Input: first line n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5); second line n arrival times; third line n departure times (arrival ≤ departure ≤ 2359).
Output: the number of platforms.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here
starterCode.javascript:
const data = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/);
// write your code here

questions.explanation: Reference approach: see the standard technique for ‘Minimum platforms’.

questions.text:

Input: first line n and K (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5, |K| ≤ 2·10^9); second line n integers (|a[i]| ≤ 10^9).
Output: the number of pairs.
